title: How to Build a CRM with AI (No Code Needed)
summary: Salesforce starts at $25/seat/month. Build your own CRM with AI in under 2 hours — contacts, pipeline, activity log, and team access. Database and auth included.
body_markdown: The honest list: native two-way email sync, polished mobile apps, SOC 2/HIPAA compliance certs, territory management for large orgs, and AI forecasting. For a 2-10 person team closing deals manually, none of those are in your daily workflow. The features you're keeping — contacts, pipeline, notes, reporting — work just as well.
